title: PROPERTY STOLEN AND RECOVERED Category of offences-4,27,167 cases, in which property was stolen, were registered in India in 1969 against 4,19,578 cases in 1968. The value of the property stolen was Rs. 3,052·47 lakhs during 1969 against Rs. 2,957·81 lakhs during 1968. “House-breaking and Thefts” accounted for 91·5% of these cases. The value of the property recovered during 1969 was Rs. 668·15 lakhs, showing a recovery of 21·9% of the property stolen against 23·4% during 1968. The highest percentage of property recovered to property stolen was recorded under the head “Robbery” (i.e. 29·1%), followed by “House-breaking and Thefts” (25·2%), while it was the least for “Dacoity” (4·1%) Table 21 presents the statistics of property stolen and recovered by different categories of offences during 1969.
